findings.summary: Independent evaluator calibration is not yet executable.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Reusable framework calibration
findings.resolution_notes: Still requires a second evaluator. Not blocking Generation 3 because the Boxercraft draft records evidence and limitations, but calibration remains required before declaring the framework reusable for client engagements.

findings.summary: PDF and print layout validation was not applicable until an output format was selected.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Client-facing PDF or print-ready report
findings.resolution_notes: Generation 2 selected Northvalley LaTeX report/deck output and validated compilation, extracted text, rendered page images, and spot-checked pages.

findings.summary: Rendered browser validation is still required before client delivery.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Mobile search, autocomplete UI, zero-result recovery, filters, and product-page recommendations
findings.resolution_notes: Generation 3 added a Playwright browser validator, rendered desktop/mobile evidence, 18 screenshots, report/deck updates, and a passing browser-validation JSON artifact for search, autocomplete, zero-result pages, filters, recommendations, mobile first viewport, and public wholesale search.

findings.summary: Authenticated wholesale account, pricing, order, and inventory workflows were not assessed because authorized access is not confirmed.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Boxercraft authenticated wholesale discovery workflow
findings.resolution_notes: Generation 3 validated public wholesale search for fleece and BM5205, but account/order/pricing/inventory workflows remain out of scope without approved access. Do not classify authenticated wholesale behavior as a defect without authorized access.

findings.summary: Broader recommendation and filter persistence samples remain useful before final external delivery.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Boxercraft recommendation and faceted navigation evidence
findings.resolution_notes: Generation 4 broadened search/autocomplete normalization and browse-routing evidence, but final delivery should still broaden recommendation samples and verify filter persistence or multi-select behavior.

findings.summary: GitHub submission is blocked because the project directory is not currently a Git repository.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: GitHub submission gate after meaningful code changes or two clean Validation Gate passes
findings.resolution_notes: Repository initialized on main, private GitHub remote origin added at https://github.com/Northvalley-Intelligence/ecommerce-product-discovery-assessment-framework.git, and initial validated project commit 3e62879cea8a548f5ed13c00c2e696589e90d1a8 pushed to origin/main. Follow-up governance metadata commit records the resolved state.

findings.summary: Full normalization evidence shows uneven search and autocomplete recovery across common apparel variants.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Boxercraft public retail search and autocomplete normalization
findings.resolution_notes: GEN-004 matrix found quarter-zip variants at 2/6 relevant search and 3/6 autocomplete, women fleece variants at 3/5, and color-plus-product variants at 4/5 search but 0/5 autocomplete. This is a valid draft finding for the Boxercraft assessment.

findings.summary: Search/autocomplete-to-browse routing is inconsistent for normalized terms.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Boxercraft search, autocomplete, collection/page recovery, and fan-shop browse routing
findings.resolution_notes: GEN-004 matrix found useful browse paths for UCLA and broad fan-shop terms, but browse-path gaps for quarter-zip and color-product variants. This is a valid draft finding for the Boxercraft assessment.

findings.summary: UCLA/Bruins discovery was tested as a stakeholder-priority set, but the client-size claim is not independently verified.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Boxercraft UCLA/Bruins priority discovery narrative
findings.resolution_notes: Report/deck language treats UCLA commercial importance as stakeholder context and validates only observed UCLA/Bruins discovery behavior: 7/8 search, 6/8 autocomplete, 8/8 search-to-browse, and 5/8 autocomplete-to-browse in the GEN-004 run.

findings.summary: Boxercraft is the only tested direct-brand site with public flannel-pant catalog matches.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Boxercraft competitor pricing benchmark
findings.resolution_notes: GEN-006 public catalog evidence found 37 Boxercraft flannel-pant products priced from $26.85 to $42.85, while L2 Brands, Colosseum Athletics, Concepts Sport, and Fanatics had no comparable public flannel-pant matches in the automated run.

findings.summary: Colosseum exposes more UCLA/Bruins public catalog matches than Boxercraft in the tested direct-site feeds.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: UCLA/Bruins public catalog discovery benchmark
findings.resolution_notes: GEN-006 found 20 Colosseum UCLA/Bruins public catalog matches versus 6 Boxercraft UCLA public catalog matches. This supports a competitive visibility finding, while UCLA commercial importance remains stakeholder context rather than independently verified public proof.

findings.summary: L2 Brands has a search/autocomplete parity gap in the GEN-006 competitor query set.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: L2 Brands rendered autocomplete and public catalog search benchmark
findings.resolution_notes: GEN-006 found 3/8 relevant search/catalog matches for the tested queries but 0/8 relevant autocomplete matches. This is useful as a competitive reference point, not a Boxercraft defect.

findings.summary: Concepts Sport and Fanatics need manual or alternate-source validation before client-facing competitor claims.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Competitor benchmark evidence quality
findings.resolution_notes: Concepts Sport is relevant as a licensed lounge/sleepwear competitor, but the public Wix catalog did not expose comparable automated price/product-grid data. Fanatics is a marketplace benchmark, not a direct brand-owned catalog comparison in this run.

findings.summary: Client-facing report status card still said GitHub submission was blocked after repository submission had been completed.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Boxercraft product discovery assessment PDF
findings.resolution_notes: Corrected reports/boxercraft-product-discovery-assessment.tex, regenerated boxercraft-product-discovery-assessment.pdf, verified extracted PDF text contains the completed GitHub status, and rendered page 6 without visible layout issues in VAL-013 and VAL-014.

findings.summary: Client-facing report did not yet answer how Boxercraft search, autocomplete, and browse compare against competitors.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Boxercraft product discovery assessment PDF
findings.resolution_notes: Added a dedicated Competitor Benchmark page to the report using existing GEN-006 evidence. The page compares Boxercraft, L2 Brands, Colosseum Athletics, Concepts Sport, and Fanatics across relevant search, autocomplete, browse evidence, weighted score/readout, and explicit evidence limits. Regenerated the PDF and validated text/layout in VAL-015 and VAL-016.

findings.summary: The Blankets browse node under-exposes products returned by search and autocomplete.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Boxercraft public retail browse, search, and autocomplete parity
findings.resolution_notes: GEN-007 found the Blankets node returned 2 browse products, while search and autocomplete for blankets reported 3 products. Lambert Soccer Everest Blanket appeared in search/autocomplete but not the Blankets browse feed.

findings.summary: Search and browse product sets are not equal across evaluated core browse nodes.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Boxercraft public retail category and fan-shop browse nodes
findings.resolution_notes: GEN-007 discovered 96 public collections and evaluated 93 non-empty nodes. Only 5/60 category or fan-shop nodes had exact search/browse product-set parity; 13/60 exposed search-only products and 51/60 exposed browse-only products.

findings.summary: Autocomplete does not consistently surface products from the corresponding browse node.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Boxercraft public retail autocomplete suggestions and browse nodes
findings.resolution_notes: GEN-007 found 47/60 category or fan-shop nodes returned no autocomplete product that matched the corresponding browse-node feed. This is suggestion coverage rather than full recall because the Boost suggestion payload is smaller than full search.

findings.source_validator: GEN-008 local school opportunity evidence review
findings.summary: Nearby school buyers do not get a clear elementary-school or PTA buying path.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Boxercraft public site navigation, school browse, and local-school positioning
findings.resolution_notes: GEN-008 report uses stakeholder-provided local PTA context and observed public collection evidence: no elementary-school browse category was observed, while school-specific public browse nodes were Lambert-related.

findings.source_validator: GEN-008 local school opportunity evidence review
findings.summary: School browse labels are not recoverable through corresponding search and autocomplete paths.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: Boxercraft school browse, search, and autocomplete discovery
findings.resolution_notes: GEN-007 evidence reused in GEN-008 found Lambert High School Spiritwear, Lambert Longhorns Spiritwear, Lambert Soccer Spiritwear, and Back to School Cozy browse nodes with public browse inventory but 0 search and 0 autocomplete products for the corresponding labels.

findings.summary: Local-school opportunity claims rely partly on a partial, medium-confidence clipboard benchmark and stakeholder-provided proximity context.
findings.affected_workflow_or_component: External-use readiness for the local school PTA executive brief
findings.resolution_notes: GEN-008 report explicitly labels the clipboard benchmark as partial, medium confidence and records that the 20-mile PTA context is stakeholder-provided. Verify service radius, school examples, turnaround, minimum-order, and fulfillment details before external use.

note: Boxercraft product-discovery findings are recorded in assessments/boxercraft/public-retail-evaluation.json. This file tracks validation lifecycle findings.
